question: How do fixed CD8 RNA states and prior repertoire-table representation relate to observed clone repetition within source mice?
decision: Determine which within-state descriptive age contrasts are supported while documenting RNA/source-table selection and inherited clone-label uncertainty.
strongest_rival: RNA dropout, source selection, age/sex imbalance and unverified blank source clone labels can mimic state-specific concentration without biological expansion or redistribution.
discriminator: Four fixed RNA states assigned without age or clone information; separate RNA and original-table denominators; within-state repetition at unchanged depth five, with explicit unsupported mouse and age contrasts.
exposure_record: Original broad CD8 repetition outcomes and repertoire metadata are exposed. Before the new RNA-state screen, 354 annotated cells, 288 exact original-source matches and 237 blank source clonal_group labels were known; all nine marker roles and the fixed rule were reviewed. No target-specific RNA state counts inspected before freeze.
biological_unit: Original source mice, with RNA cells and represented source clones nested within mouse/age; 13 RNA mice and 11 original repertoire-table mice.
nesting_and_overlap: Same exposed source study and original 6000 mouse-mapped repertoire rows. Only 288 official spleen CD8 matches enter clone analysis; 354 annotated RNA cells form a separate denominator. Source clone keys may span operational RNA states.
population_and_selection: Official FACS Spleen CD8 annotation at ages 3, 18 and 24 months, preserving post-QC cells and no new depth filter. Exact prior official_lookup join only; no formerly unassigned repertoire rows enter.
contrast: 18 minus 3 and 24 minus 3 months within each fixed state, only with at least two depth-qualified mice in each age. Equal weights to eligible mice and explicit restricted rosters.
endpoint: RNA-state counts/fractions and original-table representation fractions per mouse; within-state repeated-source-key fraction and expected repetition at depth five among represented cells only.
methods: Read and validate all raw.X integer reads against raw.var, not normalized X. Fixed nine-gene detection rule creates naive-associated, effector-associated, mixed and indeterminate states. Preserve source clone keys with inherited singleton:cell_name for blank original labels; report all 237 uses. Save all cell, denominator and cross-state occupancy primitives. Independently verify hypergeometric expectation by scalar combinations and synthetic enumeration; reconstruct original broad CD8 depth-five mouse results.
missingness_and_exclusions: All 52 mouse/state rows including zeros and RNA-only mice remain output. At least five represented cells are required per mouse/state; two qualifying mice per compared age. No invented clone for RNA-only cells, lowering depth, merging states, new labels or source expansion.
multiplicity: All four states, all mouse/state rows and eight planned age contrasts remain visible; no p-values, cell-level confidence intervals or selected favorable subset.
precision_basis: Existing mice and fixed eligibility thresholds support conditional descriptions only; no invented effect margin or power claim. RNA-only young mice do not establish failed assembly.
interpretation_limit: Analyst-defined RNA states are not validated naive/memory identity. Prior-table representation is not verified productive assembly success or a recovery rate without an attempt denominator. Blank clone labels treated as singleton by inherited convention do not prove sequence uniqueness. Different pooled/within-state populations and cross-state clones prevent fixed-composition redistribution attribution; no absolute expansion or causal mediation.
stop_rule: Stop on source/hash/layer/feature/raw-domain/identity/join/old-broad-parity conflict. Preserve failed support and unfavorable results without threshold or label tuning.
amendment_reason: New fixed RNA-state and prior-table representation extension of the original exposed CD8 cohort. No independent replication, new assembly workflow or fixed-composition decomposition. Execute in task-owned X: checkout.
